definitions.explanation: Physical exercises that extend muscles and improve flexibility.

examples.japanese: {運動|うんどう}の{前|まえ}にストレッチをする。
{毎朝|まいあさ}ストレッチをすると{体|からだ}が{軽|かる}くなる。
examples.english: Stretching every morning makes your body feel lighter.

examples.japanese: ストレッチで{筋肉|きんにく}を{伸|の}ばす。
examples.english: To stretch muscles with stretching exercises.

notes:
From English "stretch." In Japanese, ストレッチ primarily refers to stretching exercises done for health and flexibility, not the general act of stretching something.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ストレッチをする: to do stretching exercises
- ストレッチ{体操|たいそう}: stretching exercises (formal term)
- ストレッチを{行|おこな}う: to perform stretches (formal)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {準備|じゅんび}ストレッチ: warm-up stretches
- ストレッチ{素材|そざい}: stretch material/fabric
- ストレッチパンツ: stretch pants

USAGE:
Often used in fitness and health contexts. Japanese people commonly associate ストレッチ with the stretching done before and after exercise, yoga, or as part of a daily health routine. The word also appears in fashion for stretchy fabrics (ストレッチ{素材|そざい}).

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {柔軟|じゅうなん}{体操|たいそう}: flexibility exercises (more traditional/formal term)
- {準備|じゅんび}{運動|うんどう}: warm-up exercises (broader term)
